# ProofNotFluff

> Sales lead lists built from public city records, sent every Monday, plus free calculators and free Chicago data pages for trade and small business owners. Every number on the site comes from a named public source (City of Chicago, City of Austin, Chicago 311, BLS, NOAA) and carries the date it was pulled.

Contact: hello@proofnotfluff.com. Checkout is on Gumroad; small downloads are on Etsy.

## Lead lists (paid, weekly)

- [Chicago Construction Cleaning Leads: Big Projects and Their Builders](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-construction-cleaning-leads/): Free weekly sample of Chicago's biggest open building permits: apartment and commercial projects of $500,000 or more, the general contractor on each, and the ones with partial occupancy approved. $29 a month, 7-day free trial, cancel any time.
- [Austin Construction Cleaning Leads: Big Projects and Their Builders](https://proofnotfluff.com/austin-construction-cleaning-leads/): Free weekly sample of Austin's biggest open building projects: commercial and apartment projects valued at $500,000 or more, the general contractor on each, and the ones with permits already finaled. $29 a month, 7-day free trial, cancel any time.
- [Chicago Restaurant Inspection Leads for Pest Control](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-restaurant-inspection-leads/): Free weekly sample of Chicago restaurants with a failed or conditional City inspection, sorted by violation, for pest control, hood and kitchen cleaning. $39 a month, 7-day free trial, cancel any time.
- [Chicago New Business Licenses: This Week's New Licenses by Trade](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-new-business-licenses/): Free weekly sample of new Chicago business licenses by trade: restaurants, shops, salons, venues and auto shops licensed in the last 30 days, for vendors who sell to new businesses. $29 a month, 7-day free trial, cancel any time.

## Free Chicago data

- [Free Chicago Data for Trade Owners | ProofNotFluff](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-data/): Free Chicago trackers and tools for trade business owners, built from public records: permits, licenses, City contracts, repair demand, snow, rats and material prices.
- [Chicago Rat Index: Rat Complaints by Neighborhood, Weekly](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-rat-complaints/): Free Chicago Rat Index: rat complaints to 311 per 1,000 residents in all 77 community areas, with ranks, rank changes, days to close and a yearly list.
- [Chicago Trades News: Rules, Taxes, Pay and Projects](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-trades-news/): A free daily brief for Chicago contractors and trade businesses: new rules, permits, licenses, taxes, pay and big projects, in plain words with the source linked.
- [Chicago Snow Season Board for Plow Owners | ProofNotFluff](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-snow-season/): Free Chicago snow season board for plow owners: plowable days a winter at 1, 2, 3 and 6 inch triggers over 30 winters at O'Hare and Midway, by month, first and last dates, and this winter so far, from NOAA records.
- [Chicago Permit Wait Times | ProofNotFluff](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-permit-wait-times/): How long Chicago building permits take: days for half and for 8 in 10 permits from review start to issue, by permit type, review path and neighborhood, from City records, updated weekly.
- [Chicago Demolition Rodent Baiting | ProofNotFluff](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-demolition-rodent-baiting/): The rodent control step of a Chicago demolition permit in plain words, with wrecking permits issued each week by neighborhood, from City records.
- [Chicago City Contracts by Trade, Updated Daily](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-city-contracts/): Free daily tracker of City of Chicago contract awards in 12 trades: who won, what it was worth, contracts ending in the next 12 months, contract PDFs and a CSV for each trade.
- [Chicago Trade License Finder | ProofNotFluff](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-trade-licenses/): What Chicago and Illinois require for 12 trades: license, fee, insurance, bond, exam and renewal, each line linked to the agency page.
- [Chicago Public Way Permit Cost Calculator, 2026 Fees](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-public-way-permit-costs/): Free calculator for 2026 CDOT permit fees: dumpsters, work vehicles and equipment, sidewalk and street closures, and openings, from the City's schedule.
- [Chicago Dumpster Permits by Neighborhood, Updated Daily](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-dumpster-permits/): Free daily count of CDOT dumpster permits in each of Chicago's 77 community areas: last 90 days vs. a year ago, ranked, month by month. From City records.
- [What a Chicago Crew Costs: Trade Pay, Public Works Rates, Minimum Wage](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-crew-cost/): Chicago metro hourly pay for 12 trades (BLS, May 2025), Cook County prevailing wage with fringes, the 2026 Chicago minimum wage and paid leave, and a free crew day cost calculator.
- [Chicago Basement Flooding Calls by Neighborhood, Updated Daily](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-basement-flooding/): Free daily count of water in basement calls and sewer cleaning requests to Chicago 311 for all 77 community areas: month by month, vs the 12 months before, with the busiest days. From City records.
- [Chicago Repair Demand by Trade and Neighborhood, Updated Daily](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-repair-demand/): Free daily count of new Chicago building violations by trade for all 77 community areas: masonry, porches, electrical, HVAC, elevators and plumbing, with each month in the free download. From City records.
- [Material Price Changes Since Your Quote | ProofNotFluff](https://proofnotfluff.com/material-price-changes/): Free calculator: how much lumber, copper wire, concrete, steel, drywall, roofing and diesel moved since the month you quoted, from BLS producer price indexes. Chart and CSV.
- [Open Chicago Construction Projects by Neighborhood](https://proofnotfluff.com/chicago-construction-pipeline/): Free weekly count of Chicago building jobs of $500,000 or more still waiting on a certificate of occupancy, by community area and months since the permit. From City records.
